name: laravel-production-audit
description: Audit an existing Laravel 13 / PHP 8.4 application for production readiness — performance, memory footprint, reliability, concurrency, and tenancy isolation — and produce a findings report plus ready-to-use production config files. Covers HTTP lifecycle, queue/Horizon, scheduler, memory, Redis, database/N+1, PHP-FPM, OPcache, Supervisor, app config, concurrency, and multi-tenancy.
